scope_note: Complete exposed pg_amproc support-member record plus linked pg_proc identity, signature and execution properties, not unreadable C/internal compiled function bodies or member runtime behavior.
source_query_template: select row_to_json(s) as raw, md5(row_to_json(s)::text) as raw_md5, n.nspname as namespace,a.amname as method,f.opfname as family,pn.nspname as function_namespace,p.proname as function_name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as arguments,p.prorettype::regtype::text as result_type,l.lanname as language,p.prosecdef as security_definer,p.prokind as function_kind from pg_amproc s join pg_opfamily f on f.oid=s.amprocfamily join pg_namespace n on n.oid=f.opfnamespace join pg_am a on a.oid=f.opfmethod join pg_proc p on p.oid=s.amproc join pg_namespace pn on pn.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang order by n.nspname,a.amname,f.opfname,s.amprocnum,s.amproclefttype,s.amprocrighttype,s.oid
